apps.name: GrandStand
apps.subtitle: Live sport, TV, movies and replays
apps.localizedDescription: Live sport from every source in one place, free-to-air and sports channels, Twitch, full-game replays, and movies and TV shows (with a TorBox account).

versions.localizedDescription: New look: big picture tiles for games and sports, and a full-width feature at the top of Home and Movies. Wrestling added (WWE Raw, NXT, PPV events, WWE Network). Continue watching now follows you between your devices on the same TorBox account, and long-press a show to pick an episode.

Games with no working link are hidden, and Home opens straight away. US games get their real TV channel (ESPN, ABC, NBC, CBS, FOX, FS1, ACC/SEC/Big Ten Network). UFC Fight Pass and other channels start quicker and buffer less. Spanish/other-language streams filtered out. Behind the scenes: sites that move can be fixed without an update, a backup copy of the update site, and automatic problem reports (nothing personal)
